newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo says Jan-April car registrations up 16.2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Volvo says Jan-April car registrations up 16.2 pct.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker AB Volvo said on Wednesday total new car registrations rose 16.2 percent to 129,445 vehicles in the first four months of the year.
In the period the total car market was estimated at 9.37 million cars worldwide, an increase of 0.89 percent over the same period a year earlier, a Volvo spokesman told Reuters.
In the United States 30,945 new Volvo cars were registered in the period, a fall of 1.23 percent compared with the same 1996 period.
In Germany new car registrations rose 25.2 percent to 13,165 cars while in Britain they rose 34.1 percent to 14,839. In Sweden new car registrations climbed 40.7 percent to 18,305 vehicles.
